lines.ruling: Ruling: model error; i1040gi p. 98, Schedule 1, line 21: "You can take this deduction only if all of the following apply", including "You, or your spouse if filing jointly, aren't claimed as a dependent on someone else's (such as your parent's) 2025 tax return." The reply drops that condition, saying no supplied input states it, but the request's person collection carried person.sav_claimed ("Are you claimed as a dependent on someone else's 2025 tax return?"), which the project counts in sli.claimed_count. Completed stage11.sli.claimed (project $0, reply $1,200) and stage11.sli.spouse_claimed (project $0, reply $2,497.50). executable triage (.transcription/triage/2025/sli.json, executable-triage-v2): 2,063 of 2,726 agree; 6 value (3 completed), 155 candidate-unknown (20 completed: the reply reads the loan answers without sli.any), 492 candidate-refuses (refused returns, upstream refusals through line 9), 10 project-unknown. Project stands.

Ruling: representation; i1040gi p. 99, Student Loan Interest Deduction Worksheet, line 1: "Enter the total interest you paid in 2025 on qualified student loans ... Don't enter more than $2,500"; p. 98, "Don't include any amount paid from a distribution of earnings made from a qualified tuition program". Both take the interest less the unqualified and the assisted amounts, floored at zero, capped at $2,500 (subtracting the two in turn with a zero floor equals subtracting their sum), and both refuse on sa.excluded_income. The project asks sli.unqualified_any and sli.assisted_any only after sli.any; the reply reads them directly. executable triage (.transcription/triage/2025/sli.json, executable-triage-v2): 2,643 of 2,726 agree; 83 candidate-unknown (20 completed, e.g. classm.eic.1: no student loan, project $0), no value difference. Project stands.
